about.title: About
about.bio1: I'm Rohit Raj, a forward deployed engineer and AI consultant in Bengaluru, India. I join your team (your Slack, your repo, your standups), find where AI earns its place in the product, and build it until it runs in production with evals proving it works. The work is agents, MCP integrations and LLM features on the stack you already run, and it rests on 10+ years of shipping production software, from Java and Kafka backends to React Native and Kotlin apps.
about.bio2: Agents, MCP servers and LLM features, plus the production systems they live inside: WhatsApp chatbots for healthcare, a chat-to-SQL assistant, AI travel planners, privacy-first financial advisors and multi-tenant SaaS platforms. Every project ships with the infrastructure to stay up (CI/CD, observability, load tests, deployment automation) and a handover your team can run without me. I don't build demos; I build systems that run in production.
about.bio3: Before going independent, I worked on distributed systems and event-driven architecture at scale: Kafka pipelines processing millions of events, caching layers that cut database load by 80%, microservices handling thousands of concurrent requests. That background is why the AI work holds up. Most of what breaks an agent in production is the plumbing around the model, and the plumbing is where I've spent my career.
about.bio4: I document what I build because engineering work is often invisible, and you should be able to check my work before you bring me into your team. This site is that record: the problems I've solved, the architecture decisions I've made, and the trade-offs I'm still working through. Most AI products stall between demo and production. If yours is stuck there, I'd like to hear about it.
